# Timbrana

> Timbrana is construction project management software focused on project awareness for general contractors. It connects field activity, decisions, responsibility and follow-through so superintendents and project managers can see what needs attention, what is waiting and what happens next.

## Core pages
- https://timbrana.com/ — Timbrana overview
- https://timbrana.com/construction-project-management-software.html — Product scope and construction project management capabilities
- https://timbrana.com/observation-to-resolution.html — Project Flow: how everyday construction activity carries forward
- https://timbrana.com/construction-software-for-superintendents.html — Superintendent-focused workflows
- https://timbrana.com/project-awareness.html — Timbrana's Project Awareness approach

## Product boundaries
Timbrana focuses on project execution and awareness. It is not positioned as accounting, estimating or payroll software.
